Stage 1 component distributions. The layer1 layer. Facets show components 1-6 in decomposition
order; stored densities summarize sample-coordinate distributions; rugs mark sample
coordinates; dotted vertical lines mark zero; Density fills, outlines, and rug colours encode
categorical display_group. The analysis unit is independent biological observation; the design
is cross_sectional; the estimand is the descriptive distribution of sample coordinates.
Available density slices and sample-coordinate rugs are shown; unavailable slices remain
explicit. Levels with fewer than two observations (singleton) appear as rugs only. No
component-selection threshold is applied. This descriptive gallery does not rank or nominate a
biological coordinate.
